name: Meran

base.use: page ground — sits just off pure black so OLED panels stay quiet

raised.use: hero card, the one card that leads a screen

inset.use: inputs, wells, anything recessed into a card

muted.use: secondary text that still must be read

subtle.use: labels and captions — 5.3:1 on surface.raised, the floor

rgb.use: THE SWITCH — every border, shadow and gradient is authored as rgba(var(--primary-rgb), …) so a mode redefines one triplet and the whole app follows

DEFAULT.use: actions only — the button you are meant to press

hi.use: the highlight a shimmer sweeps through

DEFAULT.use: rest and recovery — the side of the app that is NOT training

reward.use: XP, rest credits, personal records — earned things

success.use: completion state only, never an action

wash.use: tinted fill behind a chip or pill

edge.use: tinted border on a tinted fill

glow.use: how hard the accent burns. A mode turns this instead of restating every shadow

breath.use: tempo multiplier for every idle animation

sans.use: all Arabic and UI text — Changa is primary, Zanjabeel the bundled fallback

mono.use: every number the user reads or compares — always with tabular-nums

xs.use: captions and secondary meta — the workhorse

md.use: lead text and primary button label

display.use: the single hero number a screen is about

black.use: screen titles and display numbers only

sm.use: quiet buttons, list rows, small cards

lg.use: hero card — the one that leads the screen

2.use: gap between related controls — the workhorse

3.use: gap between blocks inside a card

card-pad.use: fluid card padding — shrinks on a 320px phone

card-gap.use: fluid gap inside a card row

action.use: primary button — the only element that glows in its own colour

deload.intent: A week of deliberately lighter weights, legible at a glance without reading a label. Not a tint — the accent, the corner radius, the glow strength and the tempo all move together.
deload.note: The secondary must move when the primary takes blue. A rest card and a training card in the same colour would erase the one distinction the home screen depends on.

rules: Author the accent as rgba(var(--primary-rgb), …) — never a hex literal. A mode redefines one triplet and every border, shadow and gradient follows. Scattered literals are how a mode breaks.
Depth comes from the gap between surface steps, not from glow. Cards separate because they are one step lighter, and borders only assist.
Primary is for actions. Secondary owns rest and recovery. They may never resolve to the same hue — see the deload mode, where the secondary steps aside precisely because the primary takes blue.
Danger red is reserved for destructive actions. A frequent, harmless action (skipping a rest) must not wear it, or the colour stops meaning anything.

Success green marks a completed state and is never an action. It is a different green from primary on purpose; if the two are ever confusable at a glance, the primary wins and success becomes a checkmark.
Every number the user reads or compares is set in the mono face with tabular-nums, so digits do not shift width as they change.
ink.subtle is the contrast floor, not a decoration: 5.3:1 on surface.raised. Nothing that must be read goes below it.
A mode turns dials — dial.glow, dial.breath — rather than restating the rules it wants to change.
The document is RTL. Use logical properties (inline-start / inline-end), never left / right.
A Latin run inside Arabic text needs its own direction:ltr, or bidi reorders trailing marks: «6×» renders «×6», «−40%» renders «40%−».
Fluid space tokens (card-pad, card-gap, card-mb) exist because the layout must survive a 320px phone. Prefer them over fixed values for anything that stacks.
The primary button is the only element allowed to glow in its own colour. Everything else earns attention by position and size.
debt: 646 hardcoded px font sizes across JSX and zero rem rules — the type scale is documented here but not yet enforced, and the OS text-size setting has no effect on the app.
Two colour tokens resolved to the same value before this pass: secondary (#3B9DE8) and a separate blue (#3B9DE8). Collapsed into secondary.
Alpha steps were inconsistent per colour (0.10 / 0.12 for wash, 0.22 / 0.25 / 0.30 for edge). Collapsed to two steps: wash 0.10, edge 0.22.
Shipped radius tokens (18 / 12 / 6) did not match real usage (10, 12, 14, 20 dominate). The scale here follows the code, not the old declarations.
18 text elements ship at 9px or below — under the 2xs floor defined here.
